heading: Request IDs and error reports
body: Every request carries a correlation identifier (an ID that links the log lines of one request). The server creates it in its own process and passes it through the handler protocol. So in a log, you can connect a request to the controller call it caused. A handler reads the ID from the request header `x-tachyon-request-id`; the server sets this header itself, so a client cannot choose it. Failures arrive as Diagnostics v1 with stable codes. This is the same structure that a build produces. `--diagnostic-format json` makes them machine-readable. Tracing exporters (tools that send trace data to another service) are not built in.
